Subject: MAP week 3 — trajectory, outstanding risks, and owner alignment

Hi Julie + Acme team,

Following our MAP meeting this morning, I captured the core trajectory and a short list of open risks that we need to close by next Friday to keep the POC-to-pilot timeline intact. See the attached MAP_v1.2.xlsx for the row-level owners and dates. Quick highlights below: 

- Decisions made: Redwood runtime baseline (v2.1 quantized) agreed for test runs; Acme will provide the sample traffic profile by 2/5.
- Top risk: data retention requirement from procurement — they need the redlined SOW back to evaluate compliance before 2/12.
- Action tempo: we need engineering test access (staging VPC) by 2/8 for our evals to hit the 2/18 pilot cutover.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Julie: provide traffic sample + schema (due 2027-02-05) [Attachment: eval-test-results.csv placeholder]
- Ben: circulate SOW redline to Procurement (due 2027-02-04) [Attachment: SOW-draft-acme.docx]
- Lauren: prepare staging VPC access checklist and target onboarding window (due 2027-02-08)
- Monica: consolidate metrics for acceptance criteria doc (due 2027-02-09)

Please reply to confirm owners or flag anything missing. If all good, I’ll turn this into a slim decision log and push to the shared MAP spreadsheet.

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Decision log & week 3 consolidation (next steps for pilot readiness)

Team — consolidated notes and decisions from the MAP check-in (attached as a short decision log in the spreadsheet). Key outcomes: 

Decisions:
- Use Redwood runtime v2.1 quantized for all eval runs (agreed).
- Pilot acceptance criteria will require 95th pctl latency < 350ms on the sample profile and parity on top-1 accuracy within 2% of baseline.

Committed owners/dates:
- Julie (Acme) — deliver traffic sample + schema (due 2027-02-05) — STATUS: delivered 2027-02-05 15:22 PST.
- Ben (Redwood) — finalize SOW redline and return to Acme procurement (due 2027-02-04) — STATUS: sent 2027-02-04 08:41 PST.
- Lauren (Redwood) — staging access provisioning (due 2027-02-08) — STATUS: provisioning started 2027-02-08; initial cred set issued 2027-02-09 10:11 PST.
- Monica (Redwood) — acceptance criteria doc (due 2027-02-09) — STATUS: draft attached in MAP spreadsheet.

Open risks (owner recommended mitigation):
- Procurement SOW redline (owner: Ben) — mitigation: negotiate 90-day deletion clause as contract amendment to avoid delaying pilot; target decision 2027-02-12.
- Token-level observability on quantized runtime (owner: Rishi) — mitigation: run a short observability run and report metrics by 2027-02-10.

Next-week agenda (2027-02-16 cadence):
1) Pilot readiness gate review (metrics from staging evals) — owner: Monica
2) Procurement decision update + SOW finalization — owner: Ben
3) Security signoff on observability & retention — owner: Rishi
4) Post-pilot operational runbook review — owner: Lauren

Please reply with any corrections. If no objections, I’ll mark this thread as the canonical week-3 log and update the MAP spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Monica
